backend/main.mo: Actor managing user profiles and product definitions with access control and metadata tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing feature definitions, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style mapping summarizing the purpose of various frontend TypeScript and React files.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based theme tokens and CSS variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading jsPDF, JSZip, and the main React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing authentication, onboarding, profile setup, navigation, and view rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication with accessibility labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for first-time profile setup allowing users to submit their name.
frontend/src/components/errors/GlobalErr: Global React error boundary displaying a fallback card with reload option and dev error details.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportIns: Renders a card with tabbed instructions for using the app, customizing products, generating files, and selling on platforms like Gumroad or Etsy.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportScr: Provides UI to download generated product PDFs, ZIPs, or a master ZIP, with error handling and file-size formatting.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header, navigation buttons, authentication-aware actions, and view-dependent controls.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Onboa: Displays a modal containing the ExportInstructions component for onboarding, with a dismiss button.
frontend/src/components/preview/PdfPrevi: Shows a PDF preview iframe for a product or an alert if no PDF is available.
frontend/src/components/preview/UnifiedP: Displays all products with covers, descriptions, and associated PDF previews, allowing toggling of description length.
frontend/src/components/preview/ZipConte: Lists expected ZIP file contents for a product, dynamically including templates, checklists, and prompts.
frontend/src/components/products/Product: React editor for creating and modifying product entries, including modules, prompts, templates, and checklists. Provides UI for field updates and a generate action.
Manages multiple products, draft persistence, and triggering generation of single or all product bundles with error handling.
frontend/src/components/storefront/Store: Displays a product card with cover, description preview, expand/collapse, and an edit button.
Renders a storefront grid of default products with navigation back to the editor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login handling, stored identity loading, and context access.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnboardingInstruct: Manages onboarding modal visibility and persistence of whether instructions have been seen.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light/dark modes, plus accessibility-focused utility rules.
frontend/src/lib/assets/covers.ts: Provides product cover image paths and utilities to fetch cover images as blobs.
frontend/src/lib/defaultProducts.ts: Defines default product entries with full metadata including modules, prompts, templates, and checklists.
frontend/src/lib/downloads.ts: Utility functions to download blobs or File objects in the browser.
frontend/src/lib/filename.ts: Generates safe filenames and standardized PDF/ZIP names using slugs and dates.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateAllB: Generates bundles for all products and reports progress.
frontend/src/lib/generation/generateProd: Builds a complete product bundle by generating its PDF and ZIP, including cover handling.
frontend/src/lib/localDrafts.ts: Manages saving, loading, and resetting product draft data in localStorage with versioning.
Creates a PDF for a product using jsPDF, including cover, title, modules, and prompts.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildAllProductsZip: Builds a master ZIP containing all product ZIPs plus a consolidated README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/buildProductZip.ts: Creates a product ZIP with its PDF, cover, templates, checklists, prompts, and README.
frontend/src/lib/zip/readmeContent.ts: Generates README sections for usage and upload instructions for Gumroad and Etsy.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/types/productEntry.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for product entries, modules, and generated bundles.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them when needed.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s current build state, requirements, known issues, and feature definitions for the product‑generation app.
